$comment: HAND-MAINTAINED — the memory of every leaderboard triage decision, read by
Analysis publishes a slug, else '<aa-endpoint>/<normalized display name>'
(lowercase, parentheticals and resolution suffixes dropped, non-alphanumerics
collapsed to '-'; music and speech-to-text rows have no slug). Statuses:
'covered' = reachable through a unified surface; refs are 'provider/model'
and are re-validated against the live coverage sweep every run.
'partial' = served outside the unified surface (a realtime-only catalog row,
a deployment-name wire validator); reason required, refs advisory.
'excluded' = no public developer API; reason required. An entry here never
resurfaces as a gap (the data/fal/curation.json excluded doctrine), and the
audit reports stale keys, so a retired leaderboard name cannot linger.
Seeded 2026-08-25 from the native provider wave's audit (commit 7fdc549);
keys seeded before the first live run use normalized display names and get
re-keyed to real slugs as the audit reports them stale.
